records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 20 October 2026.

[2026-10-20_ETH]  
Video Title: Ethereum: $ETH Accumulation Zone Analysis  🚨📉  
Video ID: Wkwj1o6TP1g  
Ethereum (ETH) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
ETH has surged 26% over the past 90 days, trading near $246. The 20‑week SMA sits at 2100, the 200‑week SMA at 400, and the 100‑week SMA at 2700 – all well above the current price, confirming a deep accumulation phase. Composite risk metrics show a normalized risk of 2, indicating undervaluation, while the social‑sentiment wordcloud is dominated by “accumulation” and “growth” terms.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
The regression‑based fair‑value band places ETH within one standard deviation of the under‑valuation zone, with residuals showing a +34% deviation from its lifetime average. The volume‑weighted average price is roughly 2450, creating a ~90% discount to the current price of $246. Normalized risk below 2 signals undervaluation; a risk above 8 would flag overvaluation. No explicit TWAP baseline was cited, but the overall risk profile remains favorable.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
Panic‑floor support is near $1,400, while non‑panic support lies around $1,800–$1,900. Short‑term bullish models project a December peak of $3,300. A 45% annualized growth scenario projects a 2029 target of $8,200, and a 2025 target is estimated near $11,000. Machine‑learning forecasts and the 21‑week moving average reinforce a bullish cycle with a 2029 bull target of $8,200.

[2026-10-08_ETH]  
Video Title: Ethereum: $ETH Accumulation Zone Analysis  🚨📉  
Video ID: tzeGZdmmcT4  
Ethereum (ETH) | Class: CRYPTO  

   

Current Structure  
• Current trading price is hovering around $1,700 to $1,900, a 48% premium over the 90‑day time‑weighted average.  
• The 20‑week, 100‑week, and 200‑week SMAs place ETH near the 100‑week resistance, with the 200‑week SMA acting as a critical support at roughly $2,000.  
• Composite risk score is low (≈2‑3 normalized), yet higher than the median for top‑10 crypto by market cap, indicating a moderate distribution zone.  
• Social sentiment wordcloud shows high euphoria (≈43% of mentions) and strong bullish momentum, consistent with a 90‑day uptrend.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
• TWAP baseline is $1,700; current price is 1.5% above the 1‑year volume‑weighted average of $2,500.  
• Regression fair‑value band places ETH at $2,600 (fair value) with a 16% discount, indicating slight undervaluation relative to the model.  
• Undervaluation residual zone: price is 17% below fair value; overvaluation residual zone: none identified.  
• Risk tolerance: 90‑day drawdown support floor at $2,000 (non‑panic) and $1,500 (panic), with a 20‑week SMA support at $2,000.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
• Machine‑learning forecast: non‑panic floor at $2,000, panic floor at $1,500; base price range $1,900–$2,700.  
• Bull target for the current cycle: $3,500; long‑term 2030 peak projected at $7,500 (≈3x current trend, ≈4x current trend).  
• 90‑% of the 400‑day bear‑market cycle has elapsed; the cycle is expected to complete by October 2026, with a potential rally toward the 2030 peak.  

---
